items.title: 61124_Mario Bauza oral history interview
items.q: One time he had Hubert Lawes.

ctx.x: When he had a ________, a flute player, Quincy Jones, and I think they had the -- but he had a bunch of good jazz men.
Yeah. One time he had Hubert Lawes.

And he came along and one time got lucky and got hold of that (unintelligible). Then one by one the people started leaving. He started replacing with Latins. And that was the end of that. That was the end of him. Yeah, he's still living, but that was the end of him.
